newsitem.title: USA: Intellical buys WorldCom operator services.
newsitem.headline: Intellical buys WorldCom operator services.

text.p: Intellicall Inc said Wednesday it agreed to purchase the operator services business and related assets of WorldCom Inc through its ILD Communications Inc subsidiary.
Terms of the purchase were not disclosed.
Closing is scheduled for mid-1997, subject to necessary financing, regulatory approvals and other standard closing conditions.

The company said it will also enter into a long-term operator services agreement with WorldCom to handle its international and domestic operator services requirements. ILD, it said, will also enter into a network services contract with WorldCom.

Intellicall said that the assets acquired include the operator services and related long distance customer contracts, operator service centers in San Antonio, Texas; Las Vegas and Boca Raton, Fla.; and switching facilities in Dallas and Los Angeles, as well as Worldcom's billing and collection operations, and inmate operator services businesses.
Consolidated revenues for ILD, said the company, will grow to over $100 million annually from its current rate of $35 million annually.
